verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Admin API documents deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users (identities), so programmatic deletion of user data exists (docs-16, docs-30), and self-hosting is described as giving full control over your data (docs-12, docs-53). There is no documented retention policy or retention configuration. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or automatic purge, documented GDPR/data-subject deletion workflows, controls over data in the managed experimentation warehouse, and independent corroboration.
